title: ProFed: Projection-Guided Personalized Federated Learning for Low-Dose CT Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2603.13422v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Low-dose computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation exposure but introduces noise and artifacts whose appearance depends on acquisition conditions. Federated learning enables collaborative restoration without centrally pooling images, yet variation in anatomy and scanning protocols complicates learning a shared denoiser. We present ProFed, a personalized federated framework that combines image-domain feature modulation with projection-domain supervision. Anatomy and protocol descriptors condition a shared encoder--decoder, while differentiable forward-projection, backprojection, and cycle-consistency losses encourage agreement with client-local measurements. An uncertainty-weighted aggregation rule combines shared parameters and retains anatomy-specific heads locally. Following the SCAN-PhysFed benchmark, we train on eight Mayo Clinic patients and evaluate two held-out patients under eight known acquisition protocols. ProFed ac

translated_title: ProFed：面向低剂量CT去噪的投影引导个性化联邦学习
translated_abstract: 低剂量计算机断层扫描（CT）减少了辐射暴露，但会引入噪声和伪影，其表现依赖于采集条件。联邦学习能够在不集中汇总图像的情况下实现协同复原，但解剖结构差异和扫描协议的变化使得学习一个共享去噪器变得复杂。我们提出了ProFed，这是一种将图像域特征调制与投影域监督相结合的个性化联邦框架。解剖与协议描述符对共享的编码器-解码器进行条件化调节，同时可微分的正投影、反投影和循环一致性损失促使模型与客户端本地测量数据保持一致。不确定性加权聚合规则用于融合共享参数，并在本地保留解剖结构特定的输出头。遵循SCAN-PhysFed基准，我们在八名梅奥诊所（Mayo Clinic）患者上进行训练，并在八种已知采集协议下对两名留出的患者进行评估。ProFed……
tldr: ProFed提出了一种结合图像域特征调制与投影域监督的个性化联邦学习框架，通过解剖/协议描述符、可微分投影一致性损失和不确定性加权聚合，有效应对患者间解剖差异与扫描协议变化，实现低剂量CT去噪的协同训练。
en_tdlr: ProFed is a personalized federated learning framework for low-dose CT denoising that combines image-domain feature modulation with projection-domain supervision, using anatomy/protocol descriptors, differentiable projection-consistency losses, and uncertainty-weighted aggregation to handle heterogeneity across patients and scanning protocols.
